This page lists all endpoints of the [REST API](/docs/api/rest-api), grouped by topic.
Paths are relative to the API base URL, e.g., `http://localhost:3030/api`.
Endpoints marked with _no_ in the column _Session_ work without a session; all others need one (see [Authentication](/docs/api/rest-api#authentication)).
The request and response bodies are described in the OpenAPI specification and the Swagger UI of the server.

## Cache

| Method | Path           | Session | Description                                                         |
| ------ | -------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST` | `/cache/clear` |         | Clear operator results, STAC query metadata and GDAL worker caches. |

## Datasets

| Method   | Path                                                      | Session | Description                                                                                                                                                                     |
| -------- | --------------------------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST`   | `/dataset`                                                |         | Creates a new dataset referencing files. Users can reference previously uploaded files. Admins can reference files from a volume.                                               |
| `POST`   | `/dataset/auto`                                           |         | Creates a new dataset using previously uploaded files. The format of the files will be automatically detected when possible.                                                    |
| `POST`   | `/dataset/suggest`                                        |         | Inspects an upload and suggests metadata that can be used when creating a new dataset based on it. Tries to automatically detect the main file and layer name if not specified. |
| `GET`    | `/dataset/volumes`                                        |         | Lists available volumes.                                                                                                                                                        |
| `GET`    | `/dataset/volumes/{volume_name}/files/{file_name}/layers` |         | List the layers of a file in a volume.                                                                                                                                          |
| `GET`    | `/dataset/{dataset}`                                      |         | Retrieves details about a dataset using the internal name.                                                                                                                      |
| `POST`   | `/dataset/{dataset}`                                      |         | Update details about a dataset using the internal name.                                                                                                                         |
| `DELETE` | `/dataset/{dataset}`                                      |         | Delete a dataset                                                                                                                                                                |
| `GET`    | `/dataset/{dataset}/loadingInfo`                          |         | Retrieves the loading information of a dataset                                                                                                                                  |
| `PUT`    | `/dataset/{dataset}/loadingInfo`                          |         | Updates the dataset's loading info                                                                                                                                              |
| `PUT`    | `/dataset/{dataset}/provenance`                           |         |                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `PUT`    | `/dataset/{dataset}/symbology`                            |         | Updates the dataset's symbology                                                                                                                                                 |
| `POST`   | `/dataset/{dataset}/tiles`                                |         | Add a tile to a gdal dataset.                                                                                                                                                   |
| `GET`    | `/datasets`                                               |         | Lists available datasets.                                                                                                                                                       |

| `DELETE` | `/layerDb/collections/{collection}/layers/{layer}`                |         | Remove a layer from a collection                                                            |
| `POST`   | `/layerDb/collections/{parent}/collections/{collection}`          |         | Add an existing collection to a collection                                                  |
| `DELETE` | `/layerDb/collections/{parent}/collections/{collection}`          |         | Delete a collection from a collection                                                       |
| `PUT`    | `/layerDb/layers/{layer}`                                         |         | Update a layer                                                                              |
| `DELETE` | `/layerDb/layers/{layer}`                                         |         | Remove a collection                                                                         |
| `GET`    | `/layerDb/providers`                                              |         | List all providers                                                                          |
| `POST`   | `/layerDb/providers`                                              |         | Add a new provider                                                                          |

| `GET`    | `/layers/collections`                                             |         | List all layer collections                                                                  |
| `GET`    | `/layers/collections/search/autocomplete/{provider}/{collection}` |         | Autocompletes the search on the contents of the collection of the given provider            |
| `GET`    | `/layers/collections/search/{provider}/{collection}`              |         | Searches the contents of the collection of the given provider                               |
| `GET`    | `/layers/collections/{provider}/{collection}`                     |         | List the contents of the collection of the given provider                                   |
| `GET`    | `/layers/{provider}/capabilities`                                 |         |                                                                                             |

| `POST`   | `/layers/{provider}/{layer}/dataset`                              |         | Persist a raster layer from a provider as a dataset.                                        |
| `POST`   | `/layers/{provider}/{layer}/processingGraphId`                    |         | Registers a layer from a provider as a processing graph and returns the processing graph id |

## Processing Graphs

| Method | Path                                     | Session | Description                                                                                                                                                                           |
| ------ | ---------------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST` | `/datasetFromProcessingGraph/{id}`       |         | Create a task for creating a new dataset from the result of the processing graph given by its `id` and the dataset parameters in the request body. Returns the id of the created task |
| `POST` | `/processingGraphs`                      |         | Registers a new processing graph.                                                                                                                                                     |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}`                 |         | Retrieves an existing processing graph.                                                                                                                                               |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}/allMetadata/zip` |         | Gets a ZIP archive of the processing graph, its provenance and the output metadata.                                                                                                   |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}/metadata`        |         | Gets the result metadata of a processing graph                                                                                                                                        |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}/provenance`      |         | Gets the provenance of all datasets used in a processing graph.                                                                                                                       |
| `GET`  | `/processingGraphs/{id}/rasterStream`    |         | Query a processing graph raster result as a stream of tiles via a websocket connection.                                                                                               |

## Projects

| -------- | ------------------------------ | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `POST`   | `/project`                     |         | Create a new project for the user.                                         |
| `GET`    | `/project/{project}`           |         | Retrieves details about the latest version of a project.                   |
| `DELETE` | `/project/{project}`           |         | Deletes a project.                                                         |

## Session

| Method | Path                         | Session | Description                                                                                                                                            |
| ------ | ---------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `POST` | `/anonymous`                 | no      | Creates session for anonymous user. The session's id serves as a Bearer token for requests.                                                            |
| `POST` | `/login`                     | no      | Creates a session by providing user credentials. The session's id serves as a Bearer token for requests.                                               |
| `POST` | `/logout`                    |         | Ends a session.                                                                                                                                        |
| `POST` | `/oidcInit`                  | no      | Initializes the Open Id Connect login procedure by requesting a parametrized url to the configured Id Provider.                                        |
| `POST` | `/oidcLogin`                 | no      | Creates a session for a user via a login with Open Id Connect. This call must be preceded by a call to oidcInit and match the parameters of that call. |
| `GET`  | `/session`                   |         | Retrieves details about the current session.                                                                                                           |
| `POST` | `/session/project/{project}` |         | Sets the active project of the session.                                                                                                                |
| `POST` | `/session/view`              |         |                                                                                                                                                        |
| `POST` | `/user`                      | no      | Registers a user.                                                                                                                                      |
